description: One row per discrete event: clicks, key presses, station enter/exit, teleports, docent guidance, quiz responses, session lifecycle. Mirrors events_*.csv from StudyEventLogger.
note: pID / conditions / ts are auto-added by VERA. session_time_s and condition from the original header are intentionally dropped — VERA's ts and conditions already cover them.

columns.name: timestamp_utc_ms
columns.description: Unix epoch milliseconds (UTC). Use Float (double) or String — overflows a 32-bit Integer.

columns.name: platform
columns.description: VR / Desktop / WebGL. Not an IV, so not captured by the conditions column.

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: click, key_press, station_enter, station_exit, teleport, docent_guidance, quiz_response, session_start, session_end, ...

columns.name: target_id
columns.description: AttentionTarget / station / object ID this event refers to; empty if none.

columns.name: world_x
columns.description: World-space X of the event; empty when not applicable.

columns.name: world_y
columns.description: World-space Y of the event; empty when not applicable.

columns.name: world_z
columns.description: World-space Z of the event; empty when not applicable.

columns.name: screen_x
columns.description: 2D screen X for desktop/WebGL clicks; empty in VR.

columns.name: screen_y
columns.description: 2D screen Y for desktop/WebGL clicks; empty in VR.
